name: topcoder-deals-mcp
description: Topcoder (deals): search_postings, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: Live public endpoint (no reachable reference page — confidence medium): `GET /v6/challenges?status=Active&page=&perPage=`; status=Active is fixed. No documented keyword parameter, so `query`, `category` and `min_budget` are not sent. The response is a bare array; the total comes only in X-Total / X-Total-Pages headers the runtime does not read, so `total` is null and `next_page` is derived from the page size. `budget_max`/`currency` are the first prize of the first prizeSet (prizeSets[0].prizes[0].value/type); `description` is markdown; phases, track, type, numOfRegistrants and numOfSubmissions stay in `raw`.

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: `GET /v6/challenges/{id}` (challenge UUID) returns the full challenge spec; same mapping as search_postings.
